storySections.title: Basic Information
storySections.content:
Since the day she entered the prison, her memories have been stained with blood. 

The once mundane and warm recollections now feel like false dreams, blurred and cracked, turning into sharp Fragments embedded in her Caro. 

She can no longer recall the gentle embrace or caring faces; only eternal hatred and Question remain in her heart. 

Pain, humiliation, Betrayal... What caused all this suffering? 

She asks herself daily, but until freedom arrives, no one answers. 

So, she decides to seek the answers herself, interrogating every dirty heart torn from their screaming chests.

storySections.title: Story: I
storySections.content:
I seem to be involved in some supernatural event, recording all my findings here...

We were finishing our archaeology at Evrotas when I woke up and found the rest of the team had vanished, and the town looked like it reverted to a thousand years ago overnight.

Ancient ruins had risen, restoring the town to its original state, including countless residents turned to skeletons.

Excitement, shock, and fear gripped my mind. Despite having seen countless skeletons, I tremble at the sight before me. Anyone experiencing this would be even more terrified.

Everyone in this town seemed to have been brutally massacred by one person. Skeletons lay in the streets, in houses. The town gate is inexplicably tightly closed, and bodies trying to escape but brutally killed piled up by the gate, forming a small hill of bones.

I found no exceptions, men, women, old people, children... so many were killed by a massive blunt weapon, their bodies or heads smashed. Staring at the dry bones, I almost saw the blood flowing.

What happened here?

...

I searched aimlessly, found no clues until I entered the prison.

The sight there was particularly gruesome, the perpetrator destroyed the entire prison in great anger. The walls had twisted, brownish words, seeming to be written in blood by someone dying, I carefully distinguished, it seemed to read "evil spirit".

Evil spirit? Does this refer to the killer, or did the town truly experience some supernatural event?

Indeed, slaughtering the entire town alone is unimaginable, only a true ghost could ruthlessly take so many lives.

After leaving the prison, the town seemed to have subtly changed, I could smell a faint bloody scent.

While I sought a way out, the sudden sound of chains echoed through the town, as if someone was dragging something heavy forward.

Evil spirit! It's the evil spirit... it's after me! I ran desperately, but the horrifying chain sound followed me everywhere.

I was exhausted, hid under a table in a home, locked the door, but the chain sound still chased me. I heard it coming closer...

I wish this were just a dream, that everything would disappear when I wake up, wait... the sound seems to be gone, maybe the spirit has left?

...

Researcher Note: The normal handwriting ends here, only three twisted words remain, roughly deciphered as:
The door opened
—Excerpt from a deceased archaeologist's diary in the Evrotas Archaeological Team

storySections.title: Story: II
storySections.content:
Those who meet her for the first time have no desire to approach or communicate, as their survival instincts fervently warn them to stay away.

She is completely mad, or rather, a wild beast through and through.

If given the choice again, she might prefer to be a beast rather than endure everything as a human.

She trusts no one, and when her scarlet eyes gaze upon you, what you see is not suspicion but indifference and murderous intent.

She has long since scorned suspicion, seeing all people as equally base.

If you need advice on dealing with her, do not attempt to tame a true beast, for it is anything but docile. At the slightest opportunity, her claws and fangs will pierce your throat.

Leave her presence before she focuses on you, and pray that her next prey is not you.

storySections.title: Story: III
storySections.content:
Under the care and tutelage of that lady, she grew into someone kind and gentle, like a true noblewoman. Yet a single act of unwitting kindness toward a Slave was all it took for her "parents" to cast her aside without mercy.

The Spartans had never accepted her, and all her own kin despised her to the bone.

In an instant, she became a traitor in Everyone's eyes, stripped of any place where she could belong.

In that prison, every person radiated a thick malice, like some contagious plague—even though none of them had ever met before.

The endless torment in that sunless hell felt like eternity. She grew neurotically terrified of anyone approaching, unable to sleep each night. Only when she occasionally Fainted could she close her eyes in peace—yet upon opening them, she would plunge once more into an endless nightmare.

What had she done wrong? How had everything come to this?

Her Resentment drifted aimlessly with nowhere to settle, unable to untangle the logic of Fate.

Was it because she was guilty?

But if she was guilty, then the guilt of Everyone else was tenfold.

That hatred accumulated day by day into bitter fury, and the endless Anger Burning through her Blood night after night finally, one day, incinerated the cage that held her.

The chains that had been Entwined around her for years now coiled around one screaming throat after another. Over the years, the chains had long since merged with her body—they fit her hands perfectly. Gripping those blood-soaked chains, she hunted down one filthy soul after another.

Red, red, warm red, reeking red.

See? She knew it all along—not a single soul among them was pure.

storySections.title: Story: IV
storySections.content:
Her life's experiences seemed crafted to bring her suffering. Kindness, tolerance, compassion, trust—all the tender aspects of her humanity were torn away, discarded along with gory flesh. 

The word "forgiveness" was absent from her vocabulary; only the blood and hatred of others could resolve her own. 

Blood for blood, the fairest law revered by both warriors and slaves. 

A volcano that had simmered for a thousand years erupted in one night, and a hand crawled out of the underworld onto human soil. 

It was a vengeful spirit, seeking to flood the world with rivers of crimson.

daily.title: Awaken
daily.content: Such a clumsy trick... Hmph. You naive fool. Did you truly think you could bind me so easily?

daily.title: Upgrade: I
daily.content: The flames of hatred burn fiercely, never to be extinguished.

daily.title: Upgrade: II
daily.content: Those arrogant, despicable fools will die by my hand.

daily.title: Upgrade: III
daily.content: My blade of vengeance grows ever sharper.

daily.title: Enlighten: Observe
daily.content: What? You want to exploit my anger too?

daily.title: Enlighten: Ponder
daily.content: The scorching flames burn in my chest... Yes, I have never forgotten, nor can I ever forget.

daily.title: Enlighten: Reflect
daily.content: Such sweet hatred, when seasoned with the blood of foes, is surely the most exquisite dish in the world.

daily.title: Enlighten: Insight
daily.content: I think I just heard those who claimed to be my masters wailing again. How delightful.

daily.title: Enlighten: Elevate
daily.content: I want them to experience what it feels like to have their lives turned upside down, lose everything, and be trampled by everyone.

daily.title: Enlighten: Florish
daily.content: The humiliation I've endured, everything I've lost... I will make them pay. I will make them all pay.

daily.title: Affinity: I
daily.content: All who tried to control or use me ended up in the underworld at my own hands—I don't mind sending you there as well.

daily.title: Affinity: II
daily.content: Do you think a few honeyed words and a few days of false kindness will make me willingly don the shackles again and become your plaything?

daily.title: Affinity: III
daily.content: Yes, I did grovel before those people; there's no denying it. They took advantage of my ignorance, and I made them pay for it.

daily.title: Affinity: IV
daily.content: I only regret not impaling their corpses on stakes and hanging them on the walls! I will spare none who betrayed, trampled, or insulted me!

daily.title: Affinity: V
daily.content: You have always clung to that amusing trust and stayed by my side... Fine, perhaps putting you to use isn't a bad idea. But remember this: I cannot tolerate any betrayal, especially from you.

daily.title: Chat: Touch
daily.content: Hands off me.

daily.title: Chat: About Myself
daily.content: The Bloody Chain of Slaughter, Tisiphone's Messenger, Blade of Hatred... I don't care. That's just what they called me. Well, I certainly don't mind living up to them.

daily.title: Chat: About Lily
daily.content: Coward! You possess a mighty power akin to mine, yet you restrain yourself. How is that any different from willingly donning a collar?

daily.title: Chat: About Agrippa
daily.content: That "slave master," "owner of gladiators"... Ha. She is just a worthless insect.

daily.title: Chat: About Dissolution
daily.content: Capable of corroding everything, erasing all... It was quite a weapon. If only I had known back then... Heh.

daily.title: Chat: About Mythag
daily.content: Don't deceive yourself. Mental shackles are still shackles and cannot be called fair.

daily.title: Chat: What I Like
daily.content: Whenever I recall those traitors kneeling and crying for mercy, I feel a wave of satisfaction, and the flames in my heart seem to subside.

daily.title: Chat: What I Hate
daily.content: Look at these shackles on me—they're not decorations, but reminders. Reminders of betrayal and humiliation.

daily.title: Chat: About the Keeper
daily.content: Every time I see you, I think of the invisible shackles you've placed on me. Allowing you to live is my greatest act of tolerance.

battle.title: Investigation Begins
battle.content: Pay the price for your actions.

battle.title: Investigation Success
battle.content: Hatred may be alleviated, but it can never be erased.

battle.title: Exalt
battle.content: This is the will of the Three Goddesses of Vengeance!

battle.title: Over-Exalt
battle.content: Tremble under the chains of blood... Perish under the chains of blood!

traphase.title: Thinking

traphase.title: Urging
traphase.unlockCondition: Unlock after triggering this dialogue in Traphase

traphase.title: Fatal Blow
traphase.unlockCondition: Unlock after triggering this dialogue in Traphase
